findings.text: follow-on: _row sets canonical_unit to unit for every row (700/700, 204/204 and 15/15 in the three fixtures), so the field never reduces a family of near-duplicate copies and a metric keyed on canonical_unit degenerates to a per-row one.

follow-on: build_name_acceptable labels 140 WEST-correct bindings as positives in golden-name-acceptable, but section 4 lists only human-edit targets, benchmark references and ISN-accepted names as that golden's positive pool, and a WEST binding verdict judges the path-to-name binding rather than the name's acceptability, so those 140 positives rest on a source the plan does not sanction.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest omits the baseline_suite and after_suite blocks the node's manifest contract requires when a write path is a test file, so the added-failure figures have to be re-derived from the named test_logs rather than read from the record.

item_verdicts.goal: the brief's goal is three fixtures carrying labels the incumbent did not write, built by imas_codex/standard_names/judgment_goldens.py; the diff adds that module with one builder per golden and the three JSON fixtures, and every row's label_source (grammar_quarantine, human_edit_source/target, west_audit, benchmark_reference, isn_expert_review, isn_expert_reply, west_shared_identity, isn_duplicate_path_review) is outside StandardNameReview, so the goal is met though goldens C and D fall short of the named sizes.

justifications.durability: the provenance guard reddens on reinstated leak -- negative-control.log shows test_fixtures_load_with_independent_labels[golden-name-acceptable.json] failing at EXIT=1 when a reviewer_score label_source is planted -- but canonical_unit is never reduced, so no assertion tests the copy-aware key the evaluation module depends on.
justifications.evidence: committed-gate.log records 24 passed EXIT=0 at 439ced57f and baselinelog 17 passed EXIT=0 at f2b9d9ee2 (zero added failures), but the reviewed manifest at manifest.md carries no baseline_suite/after_suite keys and final-gate.log is headed REVISION=f2b9d9ee2 while running the head test set, so the recorded arm identities are inconsistent.
justifications.fit: judgment_goldens.py follows the module idiom of named builder functions returning list[dict] and keeps its Cypher in-module per the brief, with descriptive constant names and no plan or section labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: judgment_goldens.py:60-62 yields the 700-row golden-name-acceptable fixture the brief caps at 700-800 with a 200 source ceiling, but golden-description-object is 204 rows against the brief's ~300 and the distinct fixture 15 against ~111, so two of three sizes fall well short of the named targets.
justifications.reuse: the builder reuses load_labelled_fixture, REFERENCE_NAMES and GraphClient rather than forking them, and write_fixture is the single row writer the brief asks the documentation golden to share.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff (builder, three fixtures, tests, evidence fragment) is inside the manifest's declared write paths and nothing else changed.
